What marketers actually need to know about AI search this quarter

Cutting through the noise: where AI-generated answers are actually changing traffic, and the three things worth doing now.

By Nova Brief 5 September 2026 6 min read

AI answers are now a standard part of the search results page for a large share of informational queries. The effect on brand traffic is real but uneven.

Where it bites

Top-of-funnel explainer content is losing clicks to summarised answers. Transactional and branded queries are largely unaffected so far.

Three things worth doing now

  • Audit which of your top landing pages serve purely informational intent. Those are the exposed ones.
  • Make sure your best factual content is genuinely citable: clear claims, clear sourcing, structured data.
  • Track branded search volume as a proxy for the demand your other channels are creating.
The brands doing well in AI answers are the ones that were already the clearest, best-structured sources on their topic.

Source: Nova Brief analysis
